title: Phobos monolith and the proposed NASA sample mission

tellings.quote:
this uh monolith that NASA has imaged on
Phobos one of the moons of Mars

plain: NASA has photographed a monolith, a tall standing block, on Phobos, one of the moons of Mars, according to a researcher who appears as a guest. He links the object to the astronaut Buzz Aldrin and to a NASA mission that was proposed to bring back samples from that moon. If true, the object would be something worth going to Phobos to look at up close.
